titleEn: Maximum Twin Sum of a Linked List
title: 链表最大孪生和
summary: 偶数长度链表中首尾对称节点互为孪生，求所有孪生节点值之和的最大值。
insight: 快慢指针找到后半段起点，原地反转后半段，再让前半段与反转后的后半段同步前进即可逐对求和。
pitfalls: 反转会修改输入链表后半段

solutions.title: 反转后半链表
solutions.idea: 把尾部逆序后与头部对齐比较。
steps: 快慢指针：fast 每次两步、slow 每次一步，slow 停在后半起点
反转 slow 开始的链表
first=head、second=反转头，同步遍历并更新最大和

code.java: class Solution { public int pairSum(ListNode head){ListNode slow=head,fast=head;while(fast!=null){slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next;}ListNode reversed=null;while(slow!=null){ListNode next=slow.next;slow.next=reversed;reversed=slow;slow=next;}int answer=0;for(ListNode first=head,second=reversed;second!=null;first=first.next,second=second.next)answer=Math.max(answer,first.val+second.val);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun pairSum(head:ListNode?):Int{var slow=head;var fast=head;while(fast!=null){slow=slow!!.next;fast=fast.next!!.next};var reversed:ListNode?=null;while(slow!=null){val next=slow.next;slow.next=reversed;reversed=slow;slow=next};var first=head;var second=reversed;var answer=0;while(second!=null){answer=maxOf(answer,first!!.`val`+second.`val`);first=first.next;second=second.next};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int pairSum(ListNode* head){ListNode *slow=head,*fast=head;while(fast){slow=slow->next;fast=fast->next->next;}ListNode* reversed=nullptr;while(slow){ListNode* next=slow->next;slow->next=reversed;reversed=slow;slow=next;}int answer=0;for(ListNode *first=head,*second=reversed;second;first=first->next,second=second->next)answer=max(answer,first->val+second->val);return answer;} };
